entries.title: Ephesians 4:1
segments:
26
 
 Be ye angry, and sin not. The anger which is not sinful is that directed against sin, even in one's self; not against sinners, toward whom the Christly attitude is compassion.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:7
segments: According to the measure of the gift of Christ. The gift of Christ was equal to all.  Its acceptance was unequal, and its manifestation differed accordingly.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:9
segments: What is it but that he also descended? Paul's argument is that he who ascended must first have descended.  In talking with Nicodemus Jesus declared, 'No one hath ascended into heaven but he that descended out of heaven' (

entries.title: Ephesians 4:13
segments: Unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ. Paul sets the standard at the summit, as did Jesus in the Sermon on the Mount: -'Ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect (

entries.title: Ephesians 4:14
segments: By the sleight of men, in craftiness. The meaning here is beyond that of simple false teaching.  The deceit was intentional.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:17
segments: In the vanity of their mind. Vanity that is-'nothingness'-as in
; not the self-conceit of the Pharisees.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:18
segments: Darkened in their understanding. Unable even to grasp the truth.  In the words of Jesus: 'He that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth' (

entries.title: Ephesians 4:19
segments: Being past feeling. 'Lost to the accusations of conscience.' This condition is explained in
: -'Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up unto a reprobate mind.' See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:22
segments: The lusts of deceit. The enticements of earthly pleasures and desires which lead only to ruin.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:29
segments: Corrupt speech. It is by speech that good or evil thought becomes active.  James calls the tongue, 'the world of iniquity among our members... full of deadly poison' (
).  The warning of Paul is not to give utterance too a corrupting thought.  See

entries.title: Ephesians 4:30
segments: Sealed unto the day of redemption. Circumcision is spoken of as the seal of Abraham's faith (
).  The seal of redemption was the indwelling of the Holy Spirit, but salvation was to be worked out (
), unto the day of complete redemption.
